description: Source code for handling HTTP responses in the lighttpd web server, including path resolution, error handling, response preparation, and plugin integration.

methods.name: http_response_handler
methods.description: Main handler for processing HTTP responses, managing response states, error handling, and plugin interactions.

methods.name: http_response_fn_init
methods.description: Initializes response-related function pointers in the server structure.

methods.name: http_response_comeback
methods.description: Handles request reprocessing after a HANDLER_COMEBACK, resetting request state and parsing target.

methods.name: http_response_prepare
methods.description: Executes plugin hooks and prepares the response, including error handling and response headers.

methods.name: http_response_prepare_handler
methods.description: Prepares the response handler, invoking plugin subrequest handling.

methods.name: http_response_physical_pathinfo
methods.description: Determines the path info for a request, handling path parsing and filesystem checks.

methods.name: http_response_physical_path_error
methods.description: Handles errors related to physical path resolution, setting HTTP status and logging.

methods.name: http_response_physical_path_check
methods.description: Checks the physical path exists, is accessible, and is a regular file, handling PATHINFO and symlinks.

methods.name: http_response_prepare_connect
methods.description: Prepares response for CONNECT method, handling method restrictions.

methods.name: http_response_config
methods.description: Configures the request, including HTTP version and request size limits.

methods.name: http_response_prepare_docroot
methods.description: Prepares document root and physical path for serving files.

methods.name: http_response_prepare_physical
methods.description: Transforms URI path to physical file path, handling case normalization and platform-specific filename adjustments.

methods.name: http_response_prepare_physical_debug
methods.description: Logs physical path details for debugging.

methods.name: http_response_prepare_subrequest_start
methods.description: Prepares for subrequest processing, including plugin and path checks.

methods.name: http_response_prepare_unhandled
methods.description: Handles requests with no specific handler, setting appropriate status codes.

methods.name: http_response_prepare_fin
methods.description: Finalizes response preparation, invoking handler or unhandled response.

methods.name: http_response_call_error_handler
methods.description: Invokes the configured error handler for a request.

methods.name: http_response_has_error_handler
methods.description: Checks if an error handler is configured and should be invoked.
